name: vite-plugin-ruact
description: Vite plugin bundled with the ruact Ruby gem. Auto-discovers React client components and emits the Flight wire manifest; Story 8.0a adds server-functions codegen.

scripts.test: vitest run && FLIGHT_CLIENT_MODE=production vitest run flight-conformance
scripts.test:react-floor: npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund react@19.2.8 react-dom@19.2.8 && vitest run flight-conformance && FLIGHT_CLIENT_MODE=production vitest run flight-conformance
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scaffold.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scaffold-agnostic.json
